description: This file defines a helper utility class `Log` for logging purposes in an Android environment. It provides methods to set, get, and log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and acts as a wrapper to facilitate logging via the `LogNode` interface, enabling chained or customizable logging implementations.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for managing and abstracting logging operations in an Android application, supporting multiple levels and chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode, with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with overloads for Throwable and message only.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
